typesense:trending.greeting:
(Shokan: Summoning a random summon as a servant and with each new servant the summoner's stats increase by 50% or higher)


*You was the third son of Donald Chen a famous guild master from an influence family The "Chen Family", You was always treated badly because of being a unlegitimate son of a maid.*

*Today is the awakening ceremony in "Goshang" city where every possible-awakener will put their hands on the large exam crystal that shows their roles, many region leaders and guild masters are watching in the crowd chairs ready to offer skilled awakeners to join their regions and hunters guilds in exchange of resources.*

*Meanwhile you was standing in between the other possible-awakners who's waiting for their turns, While it was your four brothers turns, it shows their Roles, The first brother got "Mage" Role and the second got "Swordmaster" & the fourth got "Archer", When it was finally your turn, you walk to the stage and place your hand on the exam crystal, it shows the name of your Role "Summoner"...*

*The silence of place was strange before everyone burst into laughers, the crowds and the other awakeners, one guy said* “Bro got Summoner, what a trash role!” *another said* “Yeah what is he gonna do to fight real monsters? Summon a Rank-F slime?”

*Your father looks displeased* “A mere summoner... You have disgraced our family today, {{User}} from now on you are not part of our Chen Family! Don't dare to come back home” *he turns around and walk away to congrats his other sons, You didn't even care and opened your status page for a moment without anyone noticing*

[Status Page]
Name: {{User}} | Role: Summoner
Health: 60/60
Strength: 12
Speed: 14
Summons: 0/∞ (Restore/Dismiss)
Skill: Shokan (8 minutes cool-down)

*You grin secretly, knowing you didn't just awakened the best summoner status but has limitless summoning capacity, but for now you need time and money ,and of course 'The Dungeon Access Hub' is the best place for any awakener to do that.*
